senses.gloss: f.(b. h. קֹרָה; קָרַר II)cold, cooling; קוֹרַת רוח [cooling of the spirit,] satisfaction, pleasure, comfort.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:17">Ab. IV, 17</cite> <he>יפה … של ק׳ ר׳ וכ׳</he> better one hour of gratification in the hereafter than a whole life of this world.
<cite ref="Yevamot 63b:2">Yeb. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>אין אדם מוצא ק׳ ר׳ וכ׳</he> a man finds contentment only with his first wife.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 3">Lev. R. s. 3</cite>, end <he>ברוך … לך ק׳ ר׳</he> be blessed and contented.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:2:7">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>ותבא לפניך קורת נפשנו לטובה</he> and may our contentment come before thee for good; a. e.
